title: Simplified Gridfinity baseplate cell
prompt: A simplified single-cell Gridfinity-style baseplate: a 42 x 42 mm frame with 4 mm corner radius on the outside, a 36 x 36 mm opening with 1 mm corner radius, 5 mm tall. No chamfered profile, straight walls are fine.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
Eight rounded corners: four outside (R4) and four inside (R1)

notes: Real Gridfinity baseplates have a stepped chamfer profile (needs sweeps/booleans); this is the IR v0 simplification.
